title: Lundahl's Cuban missile crisis briefing for Kennedy

tellings.quote: That was Art Lundal and he got an award from Kennedy for that.

plain: During the Cuban missile crisis of 1962, an intelligence official named Arthur Lundahl briefed President John F. Kennedy at the White House and, according to the researcher Grant Cameron, received an award from Kennedy for that work. Cameron mentions it to Michels without naming a source, to show how close to the president Lundahl stood, which matters because Lundahl figures elsewhere in Cameron's account of who knew about UFOs.
